socialEmbeds.themeBoundary: Landometer-owned card shells, headers and surrounding surfaces follow the selected DS theme. Cross-origin provider internals retain provider styling and are not recoloured, inverted or represented as DS-themed content.
socialEmbeds.localObserved: Real TikTok, Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn provider content loaded in dark. A dark-light-dark switch preserved every iframe src and TikTok loaded state; the DS shell changed from rgb(252, 252, 250) to rgb(32, 41, 45), the dark embed surround was rgb(43, 53, 52), and no substitute cards appeared. At 390 px the Instagram iframe/card measured 436/499 px with 57 px before the next card and no fake blank tail.
